label: Universal law; observational setting…: UniversalLaw: individuals, atomic sentences R a and B a…
term: universal law; observational setting of a law
definition: `UniversalLaw`: individuals, atomic sentences R a and B a, and a sentence law that holds at a world exactly when every R there is B. `LawSetting`: each observation statement is about finitely many individuals (`mentions`), there are infinitely many individuals, and any individual can be made an R that is not B without changing the truth value of any observation statement not about it.
note: Stipulative: the standard reason why a universal generalization over an open domain is not entailed by finitely many observations. `TruthCore.Logic.Verificationism.Model.ravensSetting` shows the setting is satisfiable.
